notes: Spell rotations can now cast a spell twice in a row before switching (for example Arrow Bomb, Arrow Bomb, Escape), using the repeat rule tested in game: the second cast in a row costs the same, a third would cost 5 more mana, and the spell right after a double costs 5 more. Spell builds and "most damage" builds get higher, honest numbers when that order pays off (in our tests usually a few percent, up to about 40% for some builds), and "How to play" tells you the exact order. Nothing gets worse: the old alternating rotations are still tried and the best wins.
